findings.claim: The test now asserts only that stderr contains the path string. It no longer checks that the failure is a missing database, so any stderr that echoes the path (for example a permission or open error, or a usage message) would pass. The assertion is weaker than the old errno text check at identifying the missing-store cause. It also relies on the realTempDir path appearing unmodified in stderr. A symlink-resolved or cleaned form of the path would break the match, though realTempDir suggests it is already resolved.

evidence: The diff changes only one test: the missing path becomes a nonexistent file in an existing temp directory, and the stderr assertion changes from the errno text to the path.
The exit code check (exitStoreUnavailable) and the vault-unchanged check are untouched, so the core behavior assertions remain.
No production code changes, so no regression risk beyond test sensitivity.
